predecessors.name: Talpur dynasty
predecessors.text: the Khairpur branch of the Talpurs in upper Sindh, the one part of Talpur Sindh that was not annexed in 1843

successors.name: Islamic Republic of Pakistan
successors.text: Khairpur, amalgamated into West Pakistan (the page: disestablished 30 September 1955)

rulers.name: Mir Faiz Muhammad Khan Talpur II
Mir George Ali Murad Khan Talpur

ledger.x: 1843: Khairpur, whose Mir Ali Murad Talpur Napier had won over, survives the conquest of Sindh as a princely state.
30 September 1955: the Khairpur state is disestablished.

wars.name: British conquest of Sindh
wars.outcome: Napier isolated the Amir of Khairpur before Miani; when the Hyderabad Talpurs fell, Khairpur stayed a princely state.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a boundary or a survey for Khairpur; the 70 km disc is an approximation of the infobox area (15,730 km2, no year; Khairpur District: 1941 state roughly the present district).
